races.rationale: Oceanic bloodlines and deep-water ley traditions recognize Bastveig as guardian of hidden waters and sea civilizations.
Water bloodlines and ocean communities recognize Bastveig’s authority over tides and hidden waters.
All Dril'thar breathe underwater, and their ocean and reef bloodlines place the race within Bastveig’s hidden-water sphere.
Tides, reefs, trenches, coral stewardship, and ocean civilization are Bastveig’s explicit domains.
Current-reading whiskers, amphibious navigation, floating settlements, and tidal life place them under Bastveig.
